user.description: Sign in with your RalliSmart app account.

home.title: Select home
home.description: Choose which home this integration should control.

license.title: License key
license.description: New installations require a License Key. [Buy or renew a key]({website_url}). Each key works on one Home Assistant install only. Existing entries without a key retain pre-upgrade behavior in legacy compatibility mode; add a key in Options without deleting the integration.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the RalliSmart server
error.invalid_license: License key is invalid, expired, locked or already used on another install. Get a key at the license website.
error.invalid_license_server: Use a valid HTTPS server URL without credentials, query or fragment. HTTP is allowed only for loopback testing.
error.license_network: Cannot reach the license server. Check the URL / your connection.

init.title: Configure license
init.description: Add or update your License Key and server. Re-enter your current key when changing only the server. [Buy or renew a key]({website_url}). Saving validates the license and reloads this entry; account, home and entity IDs stay unchanged. Legacy compatibility: existing entries without a key keep pre-upgrade behavior until a key is added. Once configured, server license results are enforced; clearing the key is not supported.

error.invalid_license: License key is invalid, expired, locked or already used on another install. Existing settings were not changed.
error.invalid_license_server: Use a valid HTTPS server URL without credentials, query or fragment. HTTP is allowed only for loopback testing.
error.license_network: Cannot reach the license server. Existing settings were not changed. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Could not validate the license. Existing settings were not changed.
